title: Every deal you're watching, in one list — and it tells you when they sell.
blurb: Pipeline: every saved deal with score, cap rate, cash-on-cash, DSCR and cash-flow range, status tracking, and sold/pending/back-on-market tags.

scenes.line: Watching {n} deals at once? Spreadsheets fall apart fast.
alts: Watching a handful of deals at once? Spreadsheets fall apart fast.

scenes.line: Your pipeline keeps every deal on one card: score, cap rate, cash-on-cash, DSCR, and the cash-flow range across every strategy.
Sort by score, cap rate or cash flow, and the best deals rise to the top.
Track each one from watching, to offered, to under contract.
And when a deal goes pending, sells, or comes back on the market, it's tagged right on the card.

wrap: Your whole deal flow, in one place.
cover: Every deal you're watching. One list.
